protocol: Official April 9-21 training and April 22-28 validation split with four user-ID-modulo residual folds. The validation block selected the best training epoch, but no validation outcome entered an input feature and the hidden test was not accessed.

experiments.name: AutoInt with continuous watch-ratio auxiliary supervision
experiments.architecture: Full-metadata DeepFM plus one four-head self-attention interaction layer and a watch-ratio regression head weighted 0.4.
experiments.evidence: Epoch 1 peaked at 0.60785049 (0.67558509 GAUC, 0.54011589 nDCG@5), below the 0.60805260 watch-only model. Three residual folds selected zero; the remaining fold selected 0.0025 but regressed by 0.00005513. Cross-fitted primary fell to 0.61279076 and fixed primary to 0.61279285.

experiments.name: low-rank Deep Cross Network with continuous watch-ratio supervision
experiments.architecture: Full-metadata DeepFM plus two rank-16 cross layers and a watch-ratio regression head weighted 0.4.
experiments.evidence: Epoch 2 peaked at 0.60727549 (0.67510992 GAUC, 0.53944111 nDCG@5). Every residual fold selected exactly zero weight, leaving the champion unchanged.

conclusion: Continuous watch-ratio supervision did not unlock residual headroom from self-attention or explicit cross interactions. Both variants underperformed the simpler watch-ratio DeepFM and failed the user-disjoint promotion rule, so 0.6128046513 remains authoritative.
